detailed_description:

Characters and environment share the same cold storm lighting, rain highlights, contact shadows and three-dimensional rendering, without showing the reference-sheet layout.

[Shot 1] Wide establishing shot on the steep, rain-covered deck of <Subject 2>. The ship lists hard, turning the deck into a slippery slope above the black churning sea. <Subject 1> hangs beyond the outer edge, both hands gripping a slanted metal railing while her wrapped left leg stays fully covered by dark cloth and trouser fabric. Her wet jacket and ponytail hang with the angle of the ship. High above her, a lifeboat davit at the upper edge of frame shows only one remaining position. The handheld camera follows the downward slope of the deck, pressing toward Ava and emphasizing the drop beneath her. Rain strikes the deck, panicked voices cry out from offscreen, and the lifeboat davit sways with heavy mechanical rattling.

[Shot 2] At 00:02.000, close shot starting on Ava’s hands locked around the wet railing. Her fingers tighten and blanch with effort as the ship shudders, causing her body to slide a little farther outward. The camera tilts rapidly upward along the railing to Ava’s rain-covered face as she lifts her head toward the upper deck. Her wet hair and jacket pull in the wind, and her shoulders tremble with exhaustion and fear. <Subject 1> (S1) says:
<d>[Chinese] 麦迪逊，拉我上去!</d>
The wind and rain surge, the stressed railing emits a sharp metallic friction whine, and the final sound of her desperate shout is swallowed by the waves.

overall_soundscape:
Heavy continuous rain hammers the deck, clothing and railings while strong wind and crashing waves roar beneath the hull. The damaged ship groans and creaks, loose deck objects scrape and clatter, and the lifeboat davit gives dull metallic rattles. Offscreen crowd exclamations suggest panic without other characters entering the frame. In Shot 2, the storm grows louder, the railing whines under Ava’s grip, and her tearful shout carries a strained, breathless edge before being overtaken by wind and surf.

non_diegetic_music:
A low tense drone with sustained strings and a deep pulsing bass runs beneath the storm, tightening as Ava slips and lifting slightly under her desperate call. The score remains restrained so the rain, metal strain, waves and shouted dialogue remain clear, then fades into unresolved wind as the sequence ends.
